html:
G'oya

"Hamma majburiy tekshiruvdan o'tgan" degan savolni sanash bilan hal qilish mumkin: bino o'tgan turli majburiy tekshiruvlar soni majburiy tekshiruvlarning umumiy soniga teng bo'lishi kerak. Sanashdan oldin faqat ijobiy xulosalar va faqat majburiy tekshiruvlar qoladi.

Yechim

SELECT b.id, b.address
FROM buildings b
LEFT JOIN results r ON r.building_id = b.id AND r.approved = 1
LEFT JOIN checks c ON c.id = r.check_id AND c.required = 1
GROUP BY b.id, b.address
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM checks WHERE required = 1)

Ikkala filtr ham ON ichida, shuning uchun hech qanday ijobiy xulosasi yo'q bino ham guruh bo'lib qoladi, uning soni 0. Majburiy tekshiruv bo'lmasa, o'ng tomon ham 0 va hamma bino o'tadi. DISTINCT takror xulosalarni bir marta sanaydi. Namunada Sergelidagi uyning gaz xulosasi rad etilgan, u tayyor emas.

Tuzoqlar

COUNT(*) bilan sanash. Bir tekshiruvdan ikki marta ijobiy xulosa olgan bino, ikkinchi tekshiruvdan o'tmagan bo'lsa ham, "2 ta" bilan o'tib ketadi:

Noto'g'riSELECT b.id, b.address
FROM buildings b
JOIN results r ON r.building_id = b.id AND r.approved = 1
JOIN checks c ON c.id = r.check_id AND c.required = 1
GROUP BY b.id, b.address
HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM checks WHERE required = 1)

Bu so'rovda yana bir xato bor: oddiy JOIN xulosasiz binolarni guruhlashdan oldin olib tashlaydi, majburiy tekshiruv bo'lmaganda ular chiqmay qoladi.

approved ni tekshirmaslik: rad etilgan xulosa ham "o'tdi" bo'lib sanaladi.

Boshqa yo'l

Savolni teskari qo'yish mumkin: "bino ijobiy xulosa olmagan majburiy tekshiruv yo'q". Bu ikki qavat NOT EXISTS:

SELECT b.id, b.address
FROM buildings b
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM checks c
  WHERE c.required = 1
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM results r
      WHERE r.building_id = b.id AND r.check_id = c.id AND r.approved = 1
    )
)
